# #3977: Patch: follow-up to #3969 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3969 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3969 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43719501458)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`9076a3e24555`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3969 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/together/together.css:147`: `.together-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--you); }` removes the app's 2 px focus outline from the add-friend and search inputs and leaves only a 1 px border colour change, which is weaker than what these fields had before and weaker than every other themed field in the app.
  Evidence: index.css:420 gives every input `:where(button, input, a):focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--radiant); outline-offset: 2px; }`, and before #3969 both inputs had that ring. The new rule is (0,2,0), so it beats that zero-specificity rule and sets `outline: none`. The repo's other fields either keep the outline (index.css:460 `.form-card input:focus` only changes border-color and leaves the outline alone) or replace it with a ring (deckbuilder.css:196 `.db-search:focus` adds `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px …`; tavern.css:280 adds a 3 px box-shadow ring). The plan left out db-search's box-shadow because of the CSS ratchets but kept its `outline: none`. Fix: delete the `outline: none` line, so the theme's radiant outline stays and the border still turns `--you`. Add a component check in friends-screen.cy.tsx that a focused `TOGETHER_ADD_INPUT` / `TOGETHER_SEARCH` has a computed `outlineStyle` other than `none`.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
